Pocket Notes
Tap a node to open that page. Lines are [[links]] between pages.

No page selected

Pick a page on the left, or create a new one.
Your notes save automatically on this device.

Clip a link

Paste a link and Pocket Notes will fetch the page's title and a short preview for you. If a page can't be reached, the link itself is still saved.

Link a page

Pick a page from the list, or type a new title to create it.

Modules

Built-in capabilities you can switch on or off — like plugins, except they ship inside this file and never fetch anything.

New page

Export

A .weave file is plain text, so any Markdown editor can read it — and Pocket Notes reads back the full structure. Exporting the same notebook twice produces the same file.

Import report

Storage

Deletes every notebook, page, photo, voice note and drawing from this device, from both stores. Export a backup first if you want to keep them.
